steps: Bind human approval to the exact proposal head and current main base.
Export and hash the active protection payload.
Remove only Gate Integrity Sentinel from required checks; retain Universal PR Gate, PR reviews and all other rules.
Merge one dedicated protected-component PR by normal merge under Via B evidence and independent review.
Restore Gate Integrity Sentinel within 60 minutes from the new main definition.
Run base-only observation plus benign, invalid and protected-component disposable trials.
Compare the restored payload byte-for-byte with the approved target except for explicitly approved check evolution.
options.failClosed: Any missing approval, snapshot, retained Universal check, restoration or post-restore trial freezes the change.

steps: Verify the account and selected mechanism can bind bypass to one named human actor or team without exempting agents or all administrators.
Create a time-boxed bypass only after separate Council authorization tied to head, base and ceremony identifier.
Use it for one dedicated gate-change PR, revoke immediately, export the resulting rule and repeat post-restore trials.
options.failClosed: If actor binding, auditability, automatic expiry or revocation cannot be proved, this option is unavailable.

stageOneDisposableTrial.success: Both candidate checks start on each latest head; conclusions and causes match the F2-GOV-02E contract; no external effects occur.

stageTwoMainObservation.success: Exact checks from github-actions app 15368 complete on the latest head, rules enforce as approved and rollback remains immediately available.

removeTemporarilyCriteria: A documented critical security or availability incident exists and waiting for normal checks creates greater verified harm.
The exact blocking rule and affected head/base are identified; an Actions outage alone freezes merges unless the incident is critical.
A named human authorized by a separate Council decision approves the smallest field-level suspension.
The complete before-state payload is exported and hashed before mutation.
No broad, permanent, agent or silent administrator bypass is introduced.
A restoration deadline of at most 60 minutes and a named restoration owner are recorded.
After restoration, the benign, invalid and protected-component trials pass by their contracted causes before normal merging resumes.

rollback.trigger: lockout, missing or stale check, unexpected app source, merge incompatibility, false positive, unbounded ceremony or failed post-activation observation
steps: Freeze merges and record incident, actor, UTC time, head, base and observed checks.
Export the current rule before changing it and compare it with the approved payload.
Restore the immediately preceding payload; because current state has no rule, first activation rollback removes only the newly created protection.
Repeat the disposable documentation, invalid and protected-component trials before any reactivation.
evidence: before and after payloads with hashes
